scope: requested representative frames only same authorized a105 semantic trial; no model inference
method: official pymatting CF alpha+ML foreground solvers, official rembg trimap from cached min(isnet-anime Alpha, existing green-key12/110 Alpha), plus originalRGB key_green12/110==0 reliable-green hard BG seeds retained without erosion; hard green Alpha forced0; original RGB retained in known FG/BG

parameters.trimap_seed_structure: 10x10 ones square (official implementation, not final-alpha erosion)

reliable_green_rule: existing key_green(originalRGB,12,110).Alpha==0; no white or neutral RGB predicate

observations: Locking reliable key-zero BG prevents green negative-space resurrection.
ML estimated unknown-edge RGB shifts toward red/magenta and weakens the source dark hair outline.
Keeping original RGB with the same CF alpha avoids much of the red estimate but still produces soft/gray weakened outer hair boundaries.
visual_review.decision: Do not expand this CF configuration to six frames or full240. Source/core constraints alone are not a visual pass.
